name: New York State Overworld
premise: A text-first open world over New York State: towns are real population centers, roads are weighted travel edges, and quests are discovered locally instead of selected globally.

opening_registration.title: Choose Your Background
opening_registration.message: Choose one permanent background. It sets your main skill, starting gear, sponsor, money, contacts, and one obligation. It does not lock any Wolf-Winter plan. Next, take a ready-made promise and report or choose them separately. The Relief Compact lets you handle emergencies in Albany and nearby remote farms.

profiles.title: Road Warden
profiles.summary: You are trained for winter travel between Albany and remote farms.
profiles.preview: Skill edge: Fieldcraft 4. Value: Stewardship 4. Knowledge: Relief Compact and winter routes. Kit: weatherproof field kit. Sponsor: Hayden Hale. Money: $12. Standing: Road Wardens +5. Obligation: return Hayden's winter packet with an honest report.
profiles.tradeoff: Return Hayden's packet and give him an honest report.
profiles.consequence: You start with Fieldcraft 4, a weatherproof field kit, and $12. In Wolf-Winter, Defense starts at 4 instead of 3. Hayden becomes your sponsor, and you must return his packet with an honest report.

profiles.title: Relief Advocate
profiles.summary: You know how Albany handles evidence, emergency authority, and public aid.
profiles.preview: Skill edge: Mediation 4. Value: Accountability 4. Knowledge: emergency ledger and Relief Compact. Kit: sealed evidence folio. Sponsor: Jamie Tanner. Money: $25. Standing: Municipal Ledger +5. Obligation: give Rowan a truthful relief report.
profiles.tradeoff: No Fieldcraft Defense bonus. Give Rowan a truthful relief report.
profiles.consequence: You start with Mediation 4, a sealed evidence folio, and $25. Jamie becomes your sponsor. You receive no Fieldcraft Defense bonus, and you must give Rowan a truthful relief report.

profiles.title: Field Repairer
profiles.summary: You repair pumps, heaters, gates, and other equipment after regular crews leave.
profiles.preview: Skill edge: Repair 4. Value: Ingenuity 4. Knowledge: field infrastructure and Relief Compact. Kit: insulated repair roll. Sponsor: Reese Pryce. Money: $10. Standing: Ironhands Local +5. Obligation: return Reese's borrowed tools intact.
profiles.tradeoff: No Fieldcraft Defense bonus. Return Reese's tools intact.
profiles.consequence: You start with Repair 4, an insulated repair roll, and $10. Reese becomes your sponsor. You receive no Fieldcraft Defense bonus, and you must return his tools intact.

profiles.title: Independent Courier
profiles.summary: You work without a faction sponsor and carry one emergency tag in your own name.
profiles.preview: Skill edge: Streetwise 4. Value: Independence 4. Knowledge: Relief Compact and service corridors. Kit: unmarked courier satchel. Sponsor: none; Emery Sloane witnesses your bond. Money: $18. Standing: Independent Carriers +2. Obligation: return or publicly cancel the emergency tag.
profiles.tradeoff: Only +2 faction standing and no Fieldcraft Defense bonus. Return or cancel the tag.
profiles.consequence: You start with Streetwise 4, an unmarked courier satchel, and $18. You have no faction sponsor or Fieldcraft Defense bonus. Emery witnesses your bond, and you must return or publicly cancel the emergency tag.

doctrines.title: Public Repair Setup
doctrines.summary: Start as a Field Repairer with Full Compact Authority and Rowan's public report.
doctrines.trigger_category: Repair 4; first public-seal FORTIFY Repair is DC 12 instead of 14.
doctrines.preview: Start with Repair 4. Your first public-seal FORTIFY Repair is DC 12 instead of 14. Cost: 10 minutes and $0.
doctrines.tradeoff: No specialist kit, wagon assignment, second rider, or road is selected.
doctrines.consequence: All optional support and both roads remain available.

doctrines.title: Road-Warden Aid Setup
doctrines.summary: Start as a Road Warden with Aid-Only Terms and Hayden's frost report.
doctrines.trigger_category: Defense 4. First LURE LAY still +1; last feed skips +1 if that LAY succeeded. Split rail can help HUNT.
doctrines.preview: Defense starts at 4 instead of 3. The first successful LURE LAY still raises cattle alarm as listed; Aid-Only then skips the last feed's +1, not the first. Hayden's report can unlock a HUNT brace after a rail splits. Cost: 10 minutes and $0.
doctrines.tradeoff: Rowan's and Jamie's reports close. Optional support and both roads remain available.
doctrines.consequence: Specialist preparation, the wagon, June, and both roads remain available.

doctrines.title: Independent Drive Setup
doctrines.summary: Start as an Independent Courier with a personal bond and Rowan's public report.
doctrines.trigger_category: Streetwise 4; first DRIVE shutter-signal check drops from DC 12 to DC 10.
doctrines.preview: Start with Streetwise 4. Your first DRIVE shutter-signal check drops from DC 12 to DC 10. Cost: no added time and $0.
doctrines.tradeoff: No specialist kit, wagon assignment, second rider, or road is selected.
doctrines.consequence: All optional support and both roads remain available.

opening_relief_oath.title: Choose Your Wolf-Winter Promise
opening_relief_oath.message: Choose the rules you will follow during Wolf-Winter. This does not change your background, sponsor, or available field plans. Full Compact gives you Albany authority and rules for public supplies. Aid-Only leaves property decisions to Cade. A Personal Bond gives you no Albany authority and requires an exact return report. Once you confirm a report source, this promise is locked.

options.title: Accept Full Compact Authority
options.summary: Take Albany authority and accept responsibility for its public relief supplies.
options.trigger_category: FORTIFY: first public-seal Repair is DC 12 instead of 14.
options.preview: Your first public-seal FORTIFY Repair is DC 12 instead of 14. If you keep the promise, you earn one Civic resupply. Cost: 10 minutes. Using Cade's household shutters during FORTIFY breaks the promise.
options.tradeoff: During FORTIFY, use Albany's public seals instead of Cade's household shutters.
options.consequence: You gain Albany relief authority until Wolf-Winter ends.
options.access: Provisional authority, a boundary plan, and one Civic resupply after a kept return.
options.duty: If you choose FORTIFY, use Albany's public seals. Otherwise, protect lives first. Report the exact result for people, wolves, cattle, property, and public supplies.

options.title: Accept Aid-Only Terms
options.summary: Protect people and cattle while Cade keeps control of his property.
options.trigger_category: First LAY still +1; last feed skips +1 if LAY succeeded.
options.preview: The first successful LURE LAY still raises cattle alarm as listed. Aid-Only then skips the last feed's +1, not the first. A failed first LAY gets no last-feed skip. FORTIFY under Cade's terms keeps the promise but gains no check bonus. A living pack and whole herd earn one Market rest. Using Albany authority openly ends the promise as changed, not broken.
options.tradeoff: Cade controls his property. Using Albany authority openly ends the promise as changed.
options.consequence: You gain limited public authority until Wolf-Winter ends.
options.access: A witnessed count and one Market rest after a living-pack, whole-herd return.
options.duty: Protect people and cattle, leave property decisions to Cade, and report the exact result. If you use Albany authority, record the change openly.

options.title: Use a Personal Bond
options.summary: Help without Albany authority and promise an exact return report.
options.trigger_category: DRIVE: first shutter-signal check is 2 DC easier.
options.preview: Your first DRIVE shutter-signal check drops from DC 12 to DC 10. Returning the rig earns one Independent Carriers resupply. This gives no benefit to LURE, HUNT, or FORTIFY. Claiming Albany authority breaks the bond.
options.tradeoff: You receive no public authority. Claiming it later breaks the bond.
options.consequence: You remain independent and carry a personal promise until Wolf-Winter ends.
options.access: An easier first DRIVE signal and one resupply if the rig returns.
options.duty: Claim no Albany authority. Return or publicly cancel the emergency tag and report the exact result.

opening_lead_source.title: Choose One Wolf-Winter Report
opening_lead_source.message: Choose one report before leaving. You cannot add another later. Rowan's public report leaves now with public information only. Jamie's verified market report costs time and money and unlocks a route through Cade's fodder loft. Hayden's frost report costs time and can unlock a HUNT brace after a frozen rail splits.

options.title: Use Rowan's Public Report
options.summary: Leave now with the public information already in Cade's dispatch.
options.trigger_category: Public routes and the standard split-rail recovery.
options.preview: Cost: no time or money. You gain no private market route or frost brace.
options.tradeoff: Adds no private market route or frost brace.
options.consequence: You leave immediately with Rowan's public report.

options.title: Verify Jamie's Market Report
options.summary: Verify witness accounts about Cade's missing cattle feed.
options.trigger_category: After the yearling: unlock the fodder-loft route.
options.preview: After dealing with the yearling, you may enter Cade's fodder loft without binding the split rail. Taking the loft drop closes both ground approaches.
options.tradeoff: Taking the loft drop closes both ground approaches.
options.consequence: Jamie's verified report adds the fodder-loft route to your dispatch.

sponsor.note: Relief Advocate sponsor benefit: cost drops from $6 to $0, and time drops from 35 to 15 minutes.

options.title: Use Hayden's Frost Report
options.summary: Review Hayden's boundary sketch and overnight frost readings.
options.trigger_category: HUNT: an unbound rail split can unlock the frost brace.
options.preview: During ordinary HUNT, try the public wedge at the first fence rail. If frozen ground splits it, leave the pieces unbound. After killing the yearling, go north with the spear to use the frost brace. Binding the rail or taking Reese's repair plan closes this route.
options.tradeoff: Requires an attempted, unbound rail split. Reese's repair plan closes this route.
options.consequence: Hayden's report adds the conditional frost-brace route to your dispatch.

sponsor.note: Road Warden sponsor benefit: time drops from 20 to 5 minutes.

opening_preparation.title: Choose One Field Kit
opening_preparation.message: You may choose one optional field kit. Reese helps repair the failing fence. Emery adds a recovery route after a failed first LURE or DRIVE action. Jamie helps calm cattle after a specific rail recovery. Any background can use any kit. Your sponsor's kit costs less time and money. Choosing one closes the other two.

profiles.title: Take Reese's Repair Plan
profiles.summary: Take Reese's measured wedge and repair sequence for Cade's failing fence.
profiles.trigger_category: First loose fence rail: Repair check with a guaranteed recovery.
profiles.preview: At the first loose rail, make a Repair check at DC 12 instead of using the public wedge. Success braces the fence. Failure splits the rail, but you can repair it without another roll; cattle alarm then rises by 1. Taking this plan closes Hayden's frost brace.
profiles.tradeoff: Replaces the public wedge and closes Hayden's frost brace.
profiles.consequence: Reese adds one repair plan to your dispatch and offers one Works resupply after a truthful, held-byre return.

sponsor.note: Field Repairer sponsor benefit: cost drops from $4 to $0, and time drops from 25 to 10 minutes.

profiles.title: Take Emery's Recovery Route
profiles.summary: Take one recovery route for a failed first LURE feed or DRIVE signal.
profiles.trigger_category: After one failed first LURE or DRIVE action: Streetwise check at DC 12.
profiles.preview: After the first LURE feed or DRIVE signal fails, make one Streetwise check at DC 12. For LURE, success redirects the yearling alive and lowers cattle alarm by 1. For DRIVE, success removes the extra pack-pressure step. Failure spends the route. DRIVE still requires the loose hurdle either way.
profiles.tradeoff: One use only; failure spends it. DRIVE still requires the loose hurdle.
profiles.consequence: Emery adds one recovery route to your dispatch and offers one Campus rest after a truthful, held-byre return.

sponsor.note: Independent Courier sponsor benefit: cost drops from $4 to $0, and time drops from 20 to 5 minutes.

profiles.title: Take Jamie's Cattle Protocol
profiles.summary: Take one cattle-calming procedure for a difficult LURE rail recovery.
profiles.trigger_category: After the failed-feed, failed-wedge rail recovery: Mediation DC 12.
profiles.preview: This applies only after a failed first LURE feed, a failed public wedge, and a bound split rail that redirects the yearling alive. Return to Cade before the loft feed and make one Mediation check at DC 12. Success lowers cattle alarm by 1; failure raises it by 1. The protocol is then spent.
profiles.tradeoff: Works only on that rail-recovery route. Failure raises cattle alarm and spends it.
profiles.consequence: Jamie adds one cattle protocol to your dispatch and offers one Civic resupply after a truthful, held-byre return.

sponsor.note: Relief Advocate sponsor benefit: cost drops from $4 to $0, and time drops from 30 to 10 minutes.

opening_relief_allocation.title: Assign Albany's Last Relief Wagon
opening_relief_allocation.message: Albany has one relief wagon and crew. Assign it to one task: calm Cade's cattle, staff the Market warm room, or wait at the hill turn to help after a failed fortification. The other two receive no support.

options.title: Send Fodder to Cade's Herd
options.summary: Send dry fodder and two drovers ahead to calm Cade's cattle.
options.trigger_category: Exposed Ridge and clean first LURE feed: prevent its +1 cattle alarm.
options.preview: On the Exposed Ridge, a successful first LURE feed does not raise cattle alarm. A failed feed gets no benefit. The wagon cannot support Albany's warm room or a failed fortification.
options.consequence: Cade's cattle gain the pre-feed benefit. The warm room and mobile reserve receive no crew.
options.protects: A clean first LURE feed from the Exposed Ridge does not raise cattle alarm.
options.leaves_exposed: No warm-room rest or mobile fortification support.

options.title: Staff Albany's Warm Room
options.summary: Keep the crew in Albany to help vulnerable residents during the freeze.
options.trigger_category: After a held-byre return: one 15-minute Market rest.
options.preview: Wolf-Winter gains no field action. After a truthful held-byre return, take one 15-minute rest that restores fatigue. It does not heal wounds or replace supplies. Cade receives no fodder, and no mobile crew waits at the hill.
options.consequence: Albany's warm room stays staffed. Cade's herd and failed fortifications receive no wagon support.
options.protects: Vulnerable residents and one 15-minute fatigue rest after a held-byre return.
options.leaves_exposed: No cattle pre-feed or mobile fortification support.

options.title: Hold a Mobile Repair Crew
options.summary: Keep the wagon at the hill turn to support one recovered fortification failure.
options.trigger_category: After a recovered first FORTIFY failure: lower winter pressure by 1.
options.preview: After recovering from a failed first FORTIFY seal, the crew can stabilize it and lower winter pressure by 1. This does not retry the check or change your terms. A truthful held-byre return also earns one 15-minute Campus resupply. Cade receives no fodder, and the warm room receives no crew.
options.consequence: One recovered fortification can be stabilized. The returning wagon can resupply your next road.
options.protects: One recovered FORTIFY failure and one return resupply.
options.leaves_exposed: No cattle pre-feed or warm-room rest.

opening_ally.title: Choose Whether June Rides
opening_ally.message: June can join as a Road Warden if she controls cattle safety. You may accept her terms, ask her to follow your orders instead, or travel alone. Leaving without an agreement does not delay the dispatch.
opening_ally.capability: June helps once on a bloodless route. After a recovered LURE, she lowers cattle alarm. After a failed DRIVE signal, she can prevent 2 HP damage at Overrun. After an unstabilized first FORTIFY failure at pressure 3 or more, she can prevent 2 HP damage at dawn. She does not help a clean DRIVE, a pressure-2 FORTIFY, a mobile-stabilized FORTIFY, or any fight. Her help does not lower winter pressure or change the ending.
opening_ally.condition: June keeps cattle-first authority. She will not become an extra hunter, and the first wolf killed ends her place on the field team.

options.title: Let June Control Cattle Safety
options.summary: Ask June to join and control cattle safety.
options.preview: Cost: 15 additional minutes after the 5-minute talk, 20 minutes total. June can help once: lower cattle alarm after a recovered LURE, or prevent 2 HP after a failed DRIVE or an unstabilized FORTIFY at pressure 3 or higher. She does not fight and leaves after the first wolf dies. She gives no benefit to a clean DRIVE or a stabilized FORTIFY.
options.tradeoff: June controls cattle safety, never fights, and leaves after the first wolf dies.
options.consequence: June joins your field team with independent authority over cattle safety.

options.title: Ask June to Follow Your Orders
options.summary: Ask June to ride without control of cattle safety.
options.preview: Cost: 5 minutes. June refuses. She does not join, and you cannot repeat the same offer. The solo route remains available.
options.tradeoff: June refuses and does not join.
options.consequence: June stays in Albany after refusing the subordinate role.

options.title: Travel Alone
options.summary: Leave with the existing one-rider dispatch.
options.preview: Cost: no added time. All routes remain available. You receive no ally action.
options.tradeoff: No ally action. June will not join after departure.
options.consequence: You leave alone, and June remains with Albany's reserve.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Full-Compact Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you keep Full Compact, use Albany's seals lawfully, and report the exact result. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. This does not refund the seals or change Cade's refusal.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest at the Civic Counter
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after a truthful held-byre return and 13 Capital / Mohawk renown. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. This grants no supplies, wound treatment, or Works authority.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After Keeping Aid-Only Terms
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you keep Aid-Only Terms and return a living pack with the whole herd. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. This grants no property authority.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Personal-Bond Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you keep the personal bond and return the DRIVE rig. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. This does not make you Albany staff.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After Assigning the Fence Crew
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you send Albany's hill crew to rebuild Cade's outer fence. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. Other deferred losses remain unresolved.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After Assigning the Boundary Crew
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you send Albany's hill crew to rebuild Cade's abandoned outer boundary. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. Other deferred losses remain unresolved.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Pasture-Search Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you send Albany's hill crew to search for the missing cattle. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. Cade's damaged property remains unresolved.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Personal-Bond Search Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after a kept personal bond and a committed search for missing cattle. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. This does not duplicate a returned-rig supply claim.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest in Albany's Warm Room
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you staff the warm room and return with Cade's byre held. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. This does not treat wounds or refill supplies.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Mobile-Wagon Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you keep the wagon mobile and return with Cade's byre held. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After Filing the Road Warning
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you file a confidence-labelled road warning. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. This does not change the warning or create a field record.

campaign_service_rules.title: Use the Warning and Drover Rest
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after a truthful Wolf-Winter return and the calibrated road warning. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. If the drover rest also applies, both claims become this single rest.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Archive Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you preserve the route marks, uncertainty notes, and evidence history. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. This does not make the archive a legal finding.

campaign_service_rules.title: Use the Archive and Mobile Cache
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you preserve the traceable archive. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. If the mobile-wagon cache also applies, both claims become this single resupply.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After Filing the Clinic Card
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you create the clinic's frost-exposure threshold card. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. This grants no supplies and creates no legal finding.

campaign_service_rules.title: Use the Clinic and Drover Rest
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after Wolf-Winter and the clinic threshold card. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. If the drover rest also applies, both claims become this single rest.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Route-Digest Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you create a traceable digest of the returned route. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. This does not make the route evidence a legal finding.

campaign_service_rules.title: Use the Route-Digest and Mobile Cache
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after you create the traceable route digest. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. If the mobile-wagon cache also applies, both claims become this single resupply.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Reese's Repair Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after taking Reese's repair plan and returning with Cade's byre held. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After Emery's Recovery Route
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after taking Emery's recovery route and returning with Cade's byre held. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Jamie's Protocol Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after taking Jamie's cattle protocol and returning with Cade's byre held. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Nonlethal-Return Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after returning the living pack to the high wood with Cade's herd whole. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Treat the Gate Wound
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available when Cade's return reports the byre-mouth gate wound. Spend 45 minutes to treat the wound and restore 6 HP. This does not clear fatigue or refill supplies.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After Returning the DRIVE Rig
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after a bloodless DRIVE returns the signal housing and cattle rope. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. This does not treat a lasting wound.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Whole-Herd DRIVE Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after a bloodless DRIVE moves all three wolves away and saves the whole herd. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Preserved-Seal Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after FORTIFY under Cade's terms returns Albany's seals unused. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8. Cade's exposed outer property remains recorded.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After the Albany FORTIFY Watch
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after using Albany authority and its public seals to protect Cade's outer property without his help. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect June's Unused Field Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after June keeps her cattle-safety promise and confirms the living-pack return. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest at June's Reserve Desk
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after June refuses the subordinate role and you return a living pack. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue. This does not claim that June joined the field team.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Unused Repair-Wagon Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available when Cade already has sound timber for the broken fence. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest After the Gate Holds
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after the inner cattle gate holds with the committed guard wood. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue.

campaign_service_rules.title: Collect Solo-Packet Road Supplies
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after sending the dawn wagon to Cade and carrying Hedrick's packet north alone. Spend 15 minutes to refill supplies to 8.

campaign_service_rules.title: Rest at the Greenway Shelter
campaign_service_rules.summary: Available after assigning the dawn wagon and wardens north. Spend 15 minutes to clear fatigue.

scale.distance_model: great-circle miles multiplied by road-class detour factors

design_rules: You begin in one town. You can see only the current location, nearby roads, local points of interest, and local opportunities.
Every town node is a real New York population center with at least 10,000 residents in the source data.
Road distance and travel time affect play.
Major roads follow the interstate and highway network. Regional roads connect nearby population centers.
Shipped quests are discovered in towns; they are not all available at the start.
Notice boards start empty. Each fresh local action can reveal the next area, job, site, and quest lead available here.
Every local area has a point of interest, a named contact, and an event.
Local actions consume time and record discoveries in the journal.
Roads cost supplies and add fatigue. Shortages and fatigue add travel delay. Town services restore the traveler but do not remove distance.
For a generic local event, SCOUT its point of interest, TALK to its contact, INVESTIGATE it on site, then use RESOLVE <event>. Authored scenes list an exact option; use RESOLVE <event> <option>.
Every road has an ambient report. Only authored road scenes stop travel for a choice.
Resolve enough events in a region's listed towns to complete its regional arc.
Local actions can reveal exploration sites. Once revealed, EXPLORE the site for timed renown.
Route planning lists road time, condition delay, supplies, and fatigue separately before travel.
Large cities have more local areas than small towns.
Every local area has a discoverable timed job that grants renown.
An authored road scene can stop a road once. Goal-linked scenes retire after their quest; ambient reports never block travel.
Each town's local areas form a connected route network. Large cities also have shortcuts.
A discovered quest can start only from its listed local area.
Only the current area's points of interest, contacts, events, and discovered jobs are available.
Every local area has one larger exploration site in addition to its jobs, contacts, and events.

regions.name: Capital / Mohawk
regions.summary: Government offices, colleges, river crossings, canal towns, and industrial districts shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Find official work, route information, and faction contacts here.

regions.name: Central New York
regions.summary: Thruway crossroads, farms, factories, universities, and lake-effect weather shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Expect branching roads, weather trouble, and supply work.

regions.name: Finger Lakes / Genesee
regions.summary: Lake towns, river cities, vineyards, mills, medical campuses, and canal settlements shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Explore waterways, academic leads, and connected local investigations.

regions.name: Hudson Valley / Metro North
regions.summary: River cities, commuter towns, wooded ridges, estates, reservoirs, and parkways shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Fast main roads hide side sites and conflicts in the uplands.

regions.name: Long Island
regions.summary: Dense villages, coastal towns, harbors, laboratories, beaches, and crowded parkways shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Trips are short, roads are busy, and towns share overlapping leads.

regions.name: New York City
regions.summary: Ports, rail terminals, courts, markets, tunnels, universities, hospitals, and dense neighborhoods fill this metropolis.
regions.gameplay_role: Find many services, factions, and local quest leads here.

regions.name: North Country
regions.summary: Border crossings, lake ports, winter roads, military towns, and isolated service centers shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Long trips make supplies, route choice, and road encounters important.

regions.name: Southern Tier
regions.summary: River valleys, college cities, rail districts, floodplains, and border roads shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Expect longer routes, industrial mysteries, and terrain hazards.

regions.name: Western New York
regions.summary: Great Lakes ports, Niagara crossings, manufacturing towns, snow belts, and freight routes shape this region.
regions.gameplay_role: Expect winter travel, border work, and industrial problems.

regional_arcs.reward: Result: Capitol Corridor Stabilization is marked complete in the journal.

regional_arcs.reward: Result: Central Crossroads Watch is marked complete in the journal.

regional_arcs.title: Lakes and Genesee Compact
regional_arcs.summary: Resolve 3 local events in the listed towns to complete this Finger Lakes / Genesee regional arc.
regional_arcs.reward: Result: Lakes and Genesee Compact is marked complete in the journal.

regional_arcs.title: Hudson Line Recovery
regional_arcs.summary: Resolve 3 local events in the listed towns to complete this Hudson Valley / Metro North regional arc.
regional_arcs.reward: Result: Hudson Line Recovery is marked complete in the journal.

regional_arcs.summary: Resolve 3 local events in the listed towns to complete this Long Island regional arc.
regional_arcs.reward: Result: Island Artery Compact is marked complete in the journal.

regional_arcs.summary: Resolve 1 local event in the listed towns to complete this New York City regional arc.
regional_arcs.reward: Result: Five Borough Pressure Line is marked complete in the journal.

characters.name: Rowan Quill
characters.summary: Rowan Quill is Albany's records clerk.
characters.agenda: Rowan handles registration, emergency authority, public records, and completed relief reports.

variants.summary: Rowan records that you kept the Full Compact promise and used Albany's authority correctly.
variants.agenda: You may claim the one Civic resupply tied to this return. The old warrant cannot be reused.

variants.summary: Rowan records that you broke the Full Compact promise by using Cade's shutters instead of Albany's seals during FORTIFY.
variants.agenda: The farm may have survived, but the promise did not. You receive no Civic resupply for keeping it.

variants.summary: Rowan records that you kept the Aid-Only promise and did not take control of Cade's property.
variants.agenda: A living-pack, whole-herd return may qualify for Jamie's one Market rest.

variants.summary: Rowan records that you changed the Aid-Only promise by using Albany authority over Cade's property.
variants.agenda: The promise is closed as changed, not kept or broken. It grants no Market rest.

variants.summary: Rowan records that you kept the personal bond and claimed no Albany authority.
variants.agenda: If DRIVE returned its rig, you may claim one Independent Carriers resupply.

variants.summary: Rowan records that you broke the personal bond by claiming Albany authority.
variants.agenda: The field result still stands, but the broken bond grants no Independent Carriers resupply.

variants.summary: Rowan remembers giving you Full Compact authority for Wolf-Winter.
variants.agenda: Your first public-seal FORTIFY Repair is DC 12 instead of 14. Using Cade's shutters during FORTIFY breaks this promise.

variants.summary: Rowan remembers your Aid-Only promise: protect people and cattle while Cade controls his property.
variants.agenda: The first successful LURE LAY still raises cattle alarm as listed; Aid-Only then skips the last feed's +1. Using Albany authority changes and closes the promise.

variants.summary: Rowan remembers issuing no warrant and accepting your personal bond instead.
variants.agenda: Your first DRIVE signal is easier. Claiming Albany authority breaks the bond.

variants.summary: Rowan recognizes your Road Warden registration and Fieldcraft training.
variants.agenda: Registration is complete. Find Hayden at Albany Station Quarter for the Wolf-Winter dispatch.

variants.summary: Rowan recognizes your Relief Advocate registration and sealed evidence folio.
variants.agenda: Registration is complete. Find Hayden at Albany Station Quarter and report evidence separately from rumor.

variants.summary: Rowan recognizes your Field Repairer registration and Reese's borrowed tools.
variants.agenda: Registration is complete. Find Hayden at Albany Station Quarter for a damaged-boundary dispatch.

variants.summary: Rowan remembers that you refused a faction oath and accepted one emergency tag on a personal bond.
variants.agenda: You cannot repeat registration. Find Hayden at Albany Station Quarter, then return or publicly cancel the tag.

characters.name: Jamie Tanner
characters.summary: Jamie Tanner manages Albany's market and relief accounts.
characters.agenda: Jamie handles shortages, disputed deliveries, cattle reports, and market support.

variants.summary: Jamie remembers that you assigned Albany's last relief crew to the Market warm room.
variants.agenda: After a truthful held-byre return, you may take one fast fatigue rest there. It does not heal wounds or refill supplies.

variants.summary: Jamie remembers adding the cattle protocol to your Wolf-Winter packet.
variants.agenda: It gives one Mediation attempt after the specific rail recovery. Report whether it lowered or raised cattle alarm.

variants.summary: Jamie remembers that you certified the missing-feed witnesses for Wolf-Winter.
variants.agenda: The report unlocks Cade's fodder-loft route after the yearling. It does not guarantee success.

variants.summary: Jamie remembers sponsoring your Relief Advocate background.
variants.agenda: Jamie checks disputed relief reports against named witnesses. Sponsorship does not guarantee agreement.

characters.name: Hayden Hale
characters.summary: Hayden Hale dispatches road wardens and relief crews from Albany Station Quarter.
characters.agenda: Hayden handles route reports, winter dispatches, and field returns.

variants.summary: Hayden remembers that you held Albany's last relief wagon at the hill turn.
variants.agenda: It may stabilize one recovered FORTIFY failure. A held-byre return also earns one Campus resupply.

variants.summary: Hayden records a bloodless FORTIFY under Cade's terms: household and herd safe, wolves alive, seals unused, outer property exposed.
variants.agenda: You may claim one Station resupply. The exposed property remains an open relief need.

variants.summary: Hayden records a bloodless FORTIFY under Albany authority: household, herd, and property safe; seals spent; Cade refused to help.
variants.agenda: You may claim one Station rest. The spent supplies and Cade's refusal remain recorded.

variants.summary: Hayden records your Road Warden return from Wolf-Winter.
variants.agenda: The dispatch is closed. Your honest field report will affect Hayden's later assignments.

variants.summary: Hayden has closed both Wolf-Winter and The Gallowmere.
variants.agenda: He has no old winter report for you. Follow the current journey goal.

variants.summary: Hayden has closed Wolf-Winter and recorded Cade's return.
variants.agenda: Follow the current journey goal for the next report in the chain.

variants.summary: Hayden remembers that you certified his frost report for Wolf-Winter.
variants.agenda: During ordinary HUNT, attempt the public wedge. If the rail splits, leave it unbound, kill the yearling, and go north to use the brace. Skipping or repairing the rail closes this route.

variants.summary: Hayden remembers sponsoring your Road Warden background.
variants.agenda: Your Fieldcraft helps with Wolf-Winter, but you still owe an honest return report.

characters.name: June Pike
characters.summary: June Pike is a Road-Warden field leader who specializes in cattle safety.
characters.agenda: June joins Wolf-Winter only if she controls cattle safety. She helps once on a bloodless LURE, DRIVE, or FORTIFY route and does not fight.

variants.summary: June confirms the bloodless FORTIFY under Cade's terms: herd safe, public seals unused, outer property exposed.
variants.agenda: Her cattle-safety promise is kept. She records both what was protected and what remained exposed.

variants.summary: June confirms the bloodless FORTIFY under Albany authority: herd and property safe, public seals spent, Cade refused to help.
variants.agenda: Her cattle-safety promise is kept. Cade's refusal and Albany's spent supplies remain recorded.

variants.summary: June confirms that DRIVE saved everyone and the whole herd, but you returned with an untreated gate wound.
variants.agenda: Her promise is kept. The returned rig grants one Station rest, but the wound remains.

variants.summary: June confirms that everyone escaped, but two cattle are missing after the herd overran the lower gate.
variants.agenda: Her promise is kept. The returned rig grants one Station rest, and the cattle search remains open.

variants.summary: June confirms that everyone and the whole herd escaped, but the DRIVE rig was destroyed.
variants.agenda: Her promise is kept. The destroyed rig grants no returned-rig rest.

variants.summary: June confirms that she held the cattle line while the living pack left the barn.
variants.agenda: Her promise is kept. She stays with you and grants one Station resupply.

variants.summary: June confirms the living-pack result and records the two missing cattle.
variants.agenda: Her promise is kept despite the loss. She stays with you and grants one Station resupply.

variants.summary: June confirms that you released her before HUNT and completed the fight without her help.
variants.agenda: Her promise is released, not broken. She leaves the team and grants no service, but the relationship remains intact.

variants.summary: June left after the first wolf died, ending the cattle-safety agreement.
variants.agenda: Her promise is broken. She leaves the team and grants no return service.

variants.summary: June joined Wolf-Winter with control of cattle safety.
variants.agenda: She can help once after a recovered LURE, at the final DRIVE threshold, or during a failed FORTIFY watch. She leaves after the first wolf dies.

variants.summary: June refused to join without control of cattle safety.
variants.agenda: You cannot repeat the same offer. The solo Wolf-Winter dispatch remains open.

variants.summary: June remembers that you chose to travel alone.
variants.agenda: You cannot reopen the departure offer. June remains with Albany's reserve.

characters.name: Reese Pryce
characters.summary: Reese Pryce leads Albany's public repair crews.
characters.agenda: Reese handles damaged equipment, safety gates, repair plans, and Works supplies.

variants.summary: Reese remembers adding the measured repair plan to your Wolf-Winter packet.
variants.agenda: It gives one Repair check and a noisy guaranteed recovery. Report whether the fence held cleanly or needed the recovery.

variants.summary: Reese remembers sponsoring your Field Repairer background and lending you tools.
variants.agenda: You must account for every returned, broken, or missing tool.

characters.name: Emery Sloane
characters.summary: Emery Sloane manages Albany's parks and wildlife corridors.
characters.agenda: Emery handles tracks, side routes, wildlife reports, searches, and Greenway supplies.

variants.summary: Emery records that Cade's cattle survived but all three wolves died.
variants.agenda: The bloodshed can support an evidence survey, not a quiet wildlife-corridor policy.

variants.summary: Emery records two dead wolves, the old grey in the abandoned barn, two missing cattle, and every person safe.
variants.agenda: The old grey, missing cattle, and abandoned barn remain open recovery needs.

variants.summary: Emery records one dead wolf, two living wolves in the high wood, and two missing cattle.
variants.agenda: The bloodshed can support an evidence survey. The missing cattle and surviving wolves remain open work.

variants.summary: Emery remembers sending Albany's last wagon to pre-feed Cade's herd.
variants.agenda: It prevents the alarm increase after one clean Exposed Ridge LURE feed. A failed feed gets no benefit.

variants.summary: Emery records a bloodless DRIVE: everyone and the whole herd safe, all wolves alive, and your gate wound untreated.
variants.agenda: You may claim one Greenway resupply. The wound and displaced pack remain open concerns.

variants.summary: Emery records a bloodless DRIVE: everyone safe, all wolves alive, and two cattle missing.
variants.agenda: There is no whole-herd reward. The cattle search and displaced pack remain open concerns.

variants.summary: Emery records a bloodless DRIVE: everyone and the whole herd safe, all wolves alive, and the rig destroyed.
variants.agenda: You may claim one Greenway resupply. The destroyed rig remains a real supply loss.

variants.summary: Emery remembers adding one recovery route to your Wolf-Winter packet.
variants.agenda: It gives one Streetwise attempt after the first LURE feed or DRIVE signal fails. Failure spends it.

variants.summary: Emery records that the whole herd survived and the living pack moved to the high wood.
variants.agenda: You may claim one Greenway resupply. The pack's new range still needs watching.

variants.summary: Emery records that the pack survived but two cattle went missing.
variants.agenda: Finding the cattle and tracking the displaced pack now take priority over a reward.

variants.summary: Emery remembers witnessing your personal bond and emergency tag.
variants.agenda: Return or publicly cancel the tag. Independence does not erase its consequences.

characters.name: Blair Drake
characters.summary: Blair Drake records field evidence at Albany Campus Row.
characters.agenda: After Wolf-Winter, Blair can make either a quick warning with confidence limits or a slower traceable archive. You may choose only one.

variants.summary: Blair has the held-byre return and your clinic-threshold mandate.
variants.agenda: You may make the clinic threshold card and claim its rest. The route digest remains unavailable.

variants.summary: Blair has the evacuation return and your clinic-threshold mandate.
variants.agenda: You may make the clinic threshold card and claim its rest. The route digest remains unavailable.

variants.summary: Blair has the held-byre return and your traceable-route mandate.
variants.agenda: You may make the route digest and claim its resupply. The clinic card remains unavailable.

variants.summary: Blair has the evacuation return and your traceable-route mandate.
variants.agenda: You may make the route digest and claim its resupply. The clinic card remains unavailable.

local_events.title: Albany Civic Center: charter backlog
local_events.summary: Optional civic filing. It does not complete Wolf-Winter.

authored_scene.prompt: Choose one permanent filing policy. Both options cost 50 minutes and earn 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. A public record names the claims and makes later review slower but more rewarding. A protected record seals household details and makes later review faster but less rewarding.

options.title: Open a Public Relief Record
options.preview: Cost: 50 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Names and claims become public; the later return takes longer and earns more renown.
options.consequence: Rowan publishes the relief totals and household claims. This choice is permanent. The later public return takes longer, earns more renown, and keeps hardship visible for review.

options.title: Protect Household Details
options.preview: Cost: 50 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Household details stay sealed; the later return is faster and earns less renown.
options.consequence: Rowan records the totals but seals names and household details. This choice is permanent. The later protected return is faster, earns less renown, and keeps hardship private.

local_events.title: Jamie Tanner's Winter Price Policy
local_events.summary: Choose how Albany prices and releases its returned relief stock.

authored_scene.prompt: Choose one permanent price policy. Named household prices unlock later settlements of 30 minutes for 3 renown or 75 minutes for 5. An open-bid ceiling unlocks 20 minutes for 1 renown or 60 minutes for 4. You cannot change the policy after posting it.

options.title: Hold Household and Kitchen Prices
options.preview: Cost: 35 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later settlements cost 30 minutes for 3 renown or 75 minutes for 5.
options.consequence: Jamie fixes the named household and kitchen prices. Later, release the crates through the kitchen ledger in 30 minutes for 3 renown, or audit the full household chain in 75 minutes for 5.

options.title: Post an Open-Bid Ceiling
options.preview: Cost: 35 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later settlements cost 20 minutes for 1 renown or 60 minutes for 4.
options.consequence: Jamie posts a price ceiling and buyer order. Later, release the crates from the board in 20 minutes for 1 renown, or audit the full bid chain in 60 minutes for 4.

local_events.title: Hayden Hale's Cade Return Filing Standard
local_events.summary: Choose an administrative filing method for Cade's return.

authored_scene.prompt: Bind one filing method now. Each costs 20 minutes and earns 1 renown. Later, the route abstract closes the file in 30 minutes for 3 renown. The witnessed record takes 45 minutes for 4 and can raise an 8-renown held return to Rowan's 13-renown rest threshold. Neither option sends a crew, fixes a loss, or creates a service.

options.title: Bind a Route Abstract
options.preview: Cost now: 20 minutes. Reward now: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later closure: 30 minutes and 3 renown. No crew or service.
options.consequence: Hayden binds the route abstract. This does not close the packet yet. Later, it can close the record quickly without claiming that a repair, search, or boundary crew was sent.

options.title: Bind a Witnessed Return
options.preview: Cost now: 20 minutes. Reward now: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later closure: 45 minutes and 4 renown. No crew or service.
options.consequence: Hayden binds the named witness record. This does not close the packet yet. Later, it can close an audited record without claiming that a repair, search, or boundary crew was sent.

local_events.title: Reese Pryce's Hazard-Shift Charter
local_events.summary: Choose one extra safety rule for Albany Works.

authored_scene.prompt: Authorize one safety rule now. Each costs 20 minutes and earns 1 renown. The witness count later releases the shift in 45 minutes for 3 renown. The cold-set bypass takes 60 minutes for 4 and can raise an 8-renown held return to Rowan's 13-renown rest threshold. The normal 80-minute rescue and 35-minute inventory remain available.

options.title: License the Shift Witness Count
options.preview: Cost now: 20 minutes. Reward now: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later release: 45 minutes and 3 renown. From 8 starting renown, the total reaches 12, below Rowan's rest threshold.
options.consequence: Reese licenses the named witness count. After Wolf-Winter, it adds a 45-minute shift release for 3 renown. The normal rescue and inventory choices remain available.

options.title: Authorize the Cold-Set Bypass
options.preview: Cost now: 20 minutes. Reward now: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later release: 60 minutes and 4 renown. From 8 starting renown, the total reaches Rowan's 13-renown rest threshold.
options.consequence: Reese authorizes the measured bypass. After Wolf-Winter, it adds a 60-minute shift release for 4 renown. The normal rescue and inventory choices remain available.

local_events.title: Albany Greenway: trail sign damage
local_events.summary: Choose a permanent access record for the damaged Greenway crossing.

authored_scene.prompt: Choose one permanent crossing policy. Your later corridor-survey choices must follow it. A bloodshed evidence option appears only after a Wolf-Winter result with wolf deaths.

options.title: Post an Accessible Public Detour
options.preview: Cost: 35 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later, stake a quick public route or map a slower all-weather loop.
options.consequence: Emery posts a visible, accessible detour. This choice is permanent. The later survey must stake the shortest usable public route or map an all-weather public loop.

options.title: Place Quiet Wildlife Markers
options.preview: Cost: 35 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later, reset a few quiet markers or trace a slower witnessed wildlife route.
options.consequence: Emery places low-profile wildlife markers. This choice is permanent. The later survey must reset the minimum markers or trace the corridor through witnessed points.

options.title: Open a Bloodshed Evidence Record
options.preview: Cost: 30 minutes. Reward: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later, secure a quick minimum record or trace a slower, higher-renown custody chain.
options.consequence: Emery records the blood, tracks, and broken boundary. This choice is permanent and earns less than a public detour. The later survey must preserve either a minimum record or a full witnessed custody chain.

local_events.title: Albany Campus Row: Return Evidence Mandate
local_events.summary: Choose a clinic record or a route record from the Wolf-Winter evidence.

authored_scene.prompt: Choose one evidence mandate. Clinic thresholds unlock a later 20-minute card for 2 renown and one 15-minute rest. Route provenance unlocks a 45-minute digest for 3 renown and one 15-minute resupply. Neither becomes a Civic legal finding.

options.title: Set Clinic Exposure Thresholds
options.preview: Cost now: 20 minutes. Reward now: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later: a 20-minute clinic card for 2 renown and one 15-minute rest. The route digest closes.
options.consequence: Blair records the clinic thresholds and uncertainty notes. The later clinic card is available; the route digest is not. This is not a Civic legal finding.

options.title: Preserve the Route Evidence Chain
options.preview: Cost now: 20 minutes. Reward now: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Later: a 45-minute route digest for 3 renown and one 15-minute resupply. The clinic card closes.
options.consequence: Blair records the route marks, evidence chain, and missing links. The later route digest is available; the clinic card is not. This is not a Civic legal finding.

press_on.outcome: You leave the wagon to the wardens and carry the Queensbury warning onward at speed.

quests.title: The Wolf-Winter
quests.discovery: Old Cade needs help protecting his household and cattle from a wolf pack. The live dispatch has an optional second rider: June Pike. Starting without her sends you alone.

launch.prompt: Choose how to reach Cade. The road changes time, supplies, fatigue, cattle alarm, and what you can see. It does not choose your Wolf-Winter plan. Cade shows you the current ground conditions before you commit.

options.title: Take the Exposed Ridge
options.summary: Reach Cade quickly with a clear view, but arrive more tired and alarm the cattle.
options.preview: Cost: 30 minutes, 1 supply, and 25 fatigue. Cattle alarm starts at 1. You can see the byre and weather clearly. This road does not choose a field plan.
options.consequence: You spend 30 minutes, 1 supply, and 25 fatigue. Cattle alarm starts at 1, and you can see the byre and weather clearly.
options.return_summary: You reached Cade quickly by the exposed ridge. You saw the full byre, but the cattle saw you and became alarmed.

options.title: Take the Sheltered Stockway
options.summary: Keep the cattle calm and arrive less tired, but spend more time and supplies with a limited view.
options.preview: Cost: 75 minutes, 2 supplies, and 10 fatigue. Cattle alarm starts at 0. Hedges hide the byre and weather. This road does not choose a field plan.
options.consequence: You spend 75 minutes, 2 supplies, and 10 fatigue. Cattle alarm starts at 0, but hedges hide the byre and weather.
options.return_summary: You reached Cade by the sheltered stockway. The trip took longer, but you arrived less tired and kept the cattle calm.

local_jobs.title: Rowan's Winter Return Docket
local_jobs.summary: Close the winter-relief return under the filing policy you chose earlier.
local_jobs.objective: File the held-byre or evacuation result as a public or protected record.
local_jobs.reward: Reward: 1 renown for a fast protected filing or 3 renown for a slower public filing.

authored_scene.prompt: Your earlier filing policy and Wolf-Winter result determine the legal options. Public filings take longer and earn 3 renown. Protected filings are faster and earn 1. You cannot choose a new policy here.

options.title: File the Public Held-Byre Return
options.preview: Cost: 70 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown. Publish the held-byre result and every open household claim.
options.consequence: Rowan closes the public record with Cade's barn held. The met and exposed household claims remain available for public review.

options.title: Seal the Protected Held-Byre Return
options.preview: Cost: 25 minutes. Reward: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Certify the held-byre count while keeping household details sealed.
options.consequence: Rowan closes the protected record with Cade's barn held. Household details stay sealed, and only the minimum relief count is public.

options.title: File the Public Evacuation Return
options.preview: Cost: 60 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown. Publish the evacuation, losses, and every open household claim.
options.consequence: Rowan closes the public record with the farm evacuated. The losses and displaced claims remain available for public review.

options.title: Seal the Protected Evacuation Return
options.preview: Cost: 20 minutes. Reward: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Certify the evacuation while keeping household details sealed.
options.consequence: Rowan closes the protected record with the farm evacuated. Household details stay sealed, and only the minimum warning is public.

local_jobs.title: Jamie's Disputed Crates
local_jobs.summary: Settle two disputed relief-crate claims under the price policy you posted.
local_jobs.objective: Choose one fast release or one slower audit allowed by your policy.
local_jobs.reward: Reward: 1-5 renown. Slower audits earn more than fast releases.

authored_scene.prompt: Your posted price policy determines the two legal settlements. Household pricing offers 30 minutes for 3 renown or 75 for 5. Open bidding offers 20 minutes for 1 renown or 60 for 4. Choosing one closes the other settlement.

options.title: Release the Household-Price Crates
options.preview: Cost: 30 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown. Match the kitchen ledger and release the crates before service.
options.consequence: Jamie releases the crates through the protected kitchen ledger. Service resumes quickly, but the household price record is not fully audited.

options.title: Audit the Household-Price Chain
options.preview: Cost: 75 minutes. Reward: 5 Capital / Mohawk renown. Audit every household and kitchen claim before release.
options.consequence: Jamie publishes the full household claim chain and resolves the crates under the chosen price policy. The record can support later Civic review.

options.title: Release the Open-Bid Crates
options.preview: Cost: 20 minutes. Reward: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Follow the posted ceiling and buyer order, then release the crates.
options.consequence: Jamie releases the crates in the posted buyer order. Service resumes quickly, but the buyer chain is not fully audited.

options.title: Audit the Open-Bid Chain
options.preview: Cost: 60 minutes. Reward: 4 Capital / Mohawk renown. Audit the ceiling, buyer order, and every claim before release.
options.consequence: Jamie audits the full buyer chain and resolves the crates under the chosen bid policy. The record can support later Civic review.

local_jobs.title: Hayden's Cade Return Packet
local_jobs.summary: Send one follow-up crew for Cade, or close the return as paperwork only.
local_jobs.objective: Choose one repair, boundary, search, or administrative closure.
local_jobs.reward: Reward: 2-4 renown. Physical crews create one matching service; paperwork creates none.

authored_scene.prompt: Choose one follow-up before snow closes the road. A physical option sends one crew based on Cade's recorded losses. A bound filing method closes only the paperwork. This choice completes the packet; every other loss remains unresolved.

options.title: Send a Fence-Repair Crew
options.preview: Cost: 45 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown and one 15-minute Works rest. Requires a broken outer fence and a northbound dawn wagon.
options.consequence: Hayden assigns the crew to Cade's outer fence. Any missing-cattle search remains unresolved.

options.title: Send a Boundary Crew
options.preview: Cost: 35 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown and one 15-minute Works rest. Requires an abandoned boundary and a northbound dawn wagon.
options.consequence: Hayden assigns the crew to mark and repair Cade's abandoned boundary. Any missing-cattle search remains unresolved.

options.title: Send a Missing-Cattle Search
options.preview: Cost: 60 minutes. Reward: 4 Capital / Mohawk renown and one 15-minute Greenway resupply. An existing returned-rig cache satisfies the same service line.
options.consequence: Hayden assigns the crew to search the lower pasture. The packet closes, and no second fence or boundary crew is sent.

options.title: Close with the Route Abstract
options.preview: Cost: 30 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown. No crew, rest, or resupply. Requires the bound route abstract.
options.consequence: Hayden closes the paperwork under the route abstract. No repair or search is completed; every physical loss remains unresolved.

options.title: Close with the Witnessed Return
options.preview: Cost: 45 minutes. Reward: 4 Capital / Mohawk renown. No crew, rest, or resupply. Requires the bound witness record.
options.consequence: Hayden closes the audited paperwork under the witness record. No repair or search is completed; every physical loss remains unresolved.

local_jobs.title: Reese's Two Winter Lines
local_jobs.summary: Choose one Albany Works priority: rescue the shift or prepare repair stock.
local_jobs.objective: Complete one shift-rescue or inventory method; Reese handles the other priority.
local_jobs.reward: Reward: 2-5 renown, based on time and the safety rule used.

authored_scene.prompt: Choose one Works task. The normal choices are an 80-minute rescue for 5 renown or a 35-minute inventory for 2. If you authorized a safety rule before Wolf-Winter, its matching shift release also appears. Reese assigns the unchosen priority to his crew.

options.title: Rescue the Trapped Shift
options.preview: Cost: 80 minutes. Reward: 5 Capital / Mohawk renown. Isolate the hoist, brace the lane, and bring every worker through the gate.
options.consequence: The full shift leaves safely under Reese's count. Your journal records the rescue, and Reese assigns the inventory to his crew.

options.title: Inventory the Repair Reserve
options.preview: Cost: 35 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown. Count and seal every wedge, seal, and splice for the next dispatch.
options.consequence: You seal the complete repair reserve. Your journal records the inventory, and Reese assigns the shift rescue to his crew.

options.title: Release the Shift by Witness Count
options.preview: Cost: 45 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown. Requires the licensed witness count.
options.consequence: The witnesses confirm every worker, and the shift leaves through the supervised lane. This faster release earns less than the full rescue. Reese's crew handles the inventory.

options.title: Open the Cold-Set Bypass
options.preview: Cost: 60 minutes. Reward: 4 Capital / Mohawk renown. Requires the authorized cold-set bypass.
options.consequence: The measured bypass opens, and the shift leaves under a durable safety record. Reese's crew handles the inventory.

local_jobs.title: Emery's Corridor Survey
local_jobs.summary: Survey the Greenway crossing under the permanent policy you chose.
local_jobs.objective: Choose a fast field mark or a slower durable record allowed by that policy.
local_jobs.reward: Reward: 1-5 renown. Longer records earn more.

authored_scene.prompt: Your permanent crossing policy determines the legal survey options. Each policy offers one fast, lower-renown field mark and one slower, higher-renown record.

options.title: Stake the Shortest Public Detour
options.preview: Cost: 30 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown. An untreated gate wound does not block this option. This may reach Rowan's 13-renown rest threshold.
options.consequence: You mark the shortest accessible public detour. It opens now, but the record covers only this season's route.

options.title: Map an All-Weather Public Loop
options.preview: Cost: 75 minutes. Reward: 5 Capital / Mohawk renown. Treat the gate wound at Albany Station first if it is still untreated.
options.consequence: You map accessible grades, drainage, and crossings for a durable all-weather public route.

options.title: Reset the Quiet Markers
options.preview: Cost: 20 minutes. Reward: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. An untreated gate wound does not block this option.
options.consequence: You reset the minimum wildlife-corridor markers. Trained stewards can use them, but the record remains seasonal.

options.title: Trace the Witnessed Wildlife Route
options.preview: Cost: 60 minutes. Reward: 4 Capital / Mohawk renown. Treat the gate wound at Albany Station first if it is still untreated.
options.consequence: You trace the wildlife route through witnessed, low-profile points without creating a public path.

options.title: Secure the Minimum Bloodshed Record
options.preview: Cost: 15 minutes. Reward: 1 Capital / Mohawk renown. Seal the minimum evidence markers and witness initials.
options.consequence: You preserve the blood and track evidence with a minimum seasonal custody record.

options.title: Trace the Full Bloodshed Record
options.preview: Cost: 70 minutes. Reward: 5 Capital / Mohawk renown. Trace the blood, tracks, and full witnessed custody chain.
options.consequence: You create a durable bloodshed evidence record without describing the result as clean or hidden.

local_jobs.title: Albany Campus Row: Archive Query
local_jobs.summary: Turn Wolf-Winter evidence into one practical field record.
local_jobs.objective: Choose one warning, archive, clinic card, or route digest.
local_jobs.reward: Reward: 2-5 renown and one matching 15-minute rest or resupply.

authored_scene.prompt: Choose one record. A quick warning grants a rest; a traceable archive grants a resupply. Your earlier evidence mandate may add a faster clinic card or route digest. Choosing one closes the others.

options.title: Issue a Road Warning
options.preview: Cost: 35 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown and one 15-minute Campus rest. State what the evidence cannot prove.
options.consequence: Blair issues a quick warning with confidence limits. It is operational guidance, not a settled finding or legal record.

options.title: Prepare a Traceable Field Archive
options.preview: Cost: 75 minutes. Reward: 5 Capital / Mohawk renown and one 15-minute Campus resupply. Preserve evidence sources and uncertainty.
options.consequence: Blair creates an auditable field archive with its evidence gaps intact. It is not a public legal finding.

options.title: Issue the Clinic Threshold Card
options.preview: Cost: 20 minutes. Reward: 2 Capital / Mohawk renown and one 15-minute Campus rest. Requires the clinic-threshold mandate.
options.consequence: Blair issues the clinic's frost-exposure threshold card with its uncertainty notes. It is not a Civic legal finding.

options.title: Create the Route Digest
options.preview: Cost: 45 minutes. Reward: 3 Capital / Mohawk renown and one 15-minute Campus resupply. Requires the route-evidence mandate.
options.consequence: Blair creates the route digest with its evidence chain and missing links intact. It is not a Civic legal finding.
